propositions: The transition command has two conflicting force flags with different meanings: --force for start-work gate bypass and --force-close for completion-gate bypass, while claim uses --force uniformly

Renaming --force-close to --force and collapsing both into a single --force[=<reason>] flag that dispatches by target status requires rejecting the retired spelling explicitly rather than silently skipping it to avoid silent no-ops
Bare --force on a close transition must record (no reason given) as the reason, and --force=<reason> must be preferred over --reason for the audit note on start-work transitions
The parser must raise CommandError with clear messaging when --force-close is used, since the hand-rolled flag loop silently skips unknown tokens
